incident-bot: [PAGER] HIGH — edge-gateway 502 surge detected (eu-west-1). 5xx rate elevated for /v1/generate. Current 502s: 6.2% over 5m, error budget at risk. Auto-page oncall. https://status.redwood.internal/alerts/3622
Alicia (oncall): I'm on it — taking incident. Pulling runbook and timeline. tagging #incidents. grabbing logs now.
Raj (sre): seeing the same. spike started ~36s ago at 17:03:12 UTC. majority of 502s from edge-proxy -> model-serving upstream: connection resets and 504s on some requests. attaching sample log lines:
```
[17:03:14] edge-proxy-aws-12 nginx: 502 while reading response header from upstream, upstream: "http://10.0.23.4:8080/", client: 34.21.2.1, server: gateway
[17:03:15] model-svc-3 stderr: panic: runtime error: out of memory
```
Raj (sre): counts by path: POST /v1/generate ~72% of errors, GET /health unaffected.
Alicia (oncall): any recent deploys or config changes? pulling deploy bot output.
deploy-bot: deploy 36a7 by Marta (infra) -> edge-proxy config: keepalive_timeout lowered from 75s -> 30s, and upstream_max_fails tuned. canary 10% at 16:59 UTC.
Marta (infra): I can rollback the canary immediately if we think keepalive change correlated. I was tuning timeouts for idle connections. starting rollback to stable. command: `rbctl edge-config rollback --deploy=35ff2 --region=eu-west-1`
Kai (runtime): early telemetry shows increased connection churn; backend model pods are seeing connection resets and occasional OOMs at peak concurrency. suspect keepalives + sudden fanout caused backend pipe to saturate. Suggest two-step mitigation: 1) rollback edge config (Marta doing that), 2) reduce fanout / lower concurrency from edge to model-svc (feature flag) and shift some traffic to secondary region fallback.
Raj (sre): preparing traffic shift. Will move 30% traffic eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 via runtime routing. command: `rbctl route update --service=api-gateway --region=eu-west-1 --weight=70 && rbctl route update --service=api-gateway --region=eu-central-1 --weight=30`
Alicia (oncall): notifying customer-impact team and support. early impact estimate: ~12 active customers affected with elevated error rates, highest for streaming/chat integrations. creating incident page: https://incidents.redwood.internal/3622
pagerduty-bot: oncall acknowledged: Alicia (oncall) — incident timeline created.
Marta (infra): rollback in progress — reverting canary to 35ff2. patch applied, edge proxies reloaded across canary nodes.
deploy-bot: rollback 35ff2 applied to canary group. rollout status: SUCCESS (canary group).
Raj (sre): after rollback: 502 rate fell from 6.2% -> 1.1% within 90s on canary subset. starting traffic shift now to reduce load on eu-west backend.
Kai (runtime): enabled reduced fanout flag `enable_model_fanout=false` for gateway route; lowering per-request concurrency limit from 20 -> 8 for affected path. snippet:
```
rbctl feature-flag set enable_model_fanout --service=api-gateway --value=false --env=prod
rbctl config patch api-gateway --path=/v1/generate --concurrency=8
```
Alicia (oncall): monitoring metrics (latency, 5xx, p95). updating channel: mitigation in progress, rollback + traffic shift + fanout reduction. support notified of customers with degraded sessions.
Raj (sre): observability: request success rate back to 99.2% after actions. regional breakdown: eu-west-1 502s now 0.9%, eu-central-1 small bump but healthy.
Marta (infra): confirmed no config drift, rolling full revert to stable across eu-west-1. will follow up with a controlled re-test of keepalive change in staging with load harness.
Alicia (oncall): declaring incident: MITIGATED — immediate customer impact reduced. still monitoring for 30m. creating postmortem ticket and action items: (1) revert default keepalive threshold, (2) add circuit breaker on model-svc for connection queues, (3) add automatic rollback trigger for edge-proxy canaries when 5xx>1% within 2m. ticket: https://tickets.redwood.internal/INC-3622
Kai (runtime): propose longer-term: add graceful backpressure at edge, and better memory limits on model pods to avoid OOM during connection storms.
pagerduty-bot: Incident marked mitigated by Alicia (oncall) at 17:06:07 UTC. follow-up assigned.
Alicia (oncall): Thanks all — great quick coordination. I'll lead the postmortem and include timeline and runbook gaps. please add any logs or consoles to the incident doc. :thumbsup: 
incident-bot: Incident 3622 — status: mitigated. follow-ups: postmortem required, customer comms draft. created tracker INC-3622.
